contexts.text: He who is proud, is proud in every single (thing) of his will and thought.
The love of self, which is scornful contempt and pride... AC 2219:5.
So far as their pride, or worship of self, is not taken away.
As soon as their pride is taken away, they sink down into their Hell.
From their Knowledges, the Spirits of Mercury are proud above others... They replied that it is not pride; but only glorying... AC 7077.
When they heard that they were in pride, they began to humble themselves...
When the external man is not regenerate, he places all good in pride, etc.
There remained with them a pride, as if they were wiser than others.
At the east are those who have been proud...
In the pride of wisdom.
When the love of self inspires its love into its consort the understanding, it there becomes pride, which is the pride of Own intelligence.
The intellectual proprium is pride from the love of self. These two latter are like two consorts; and their marriage is called the marriage of evil and falsity.
For pride (from erudition) conglutinates falsities...
That in the New Jerusalem men will not be in Knowledges about God from... glory originating from pride. Signified, Explained.
See Lumen.
(The love of the world is worse) if it verges towards pride, and eminence over others...
Proud Spirits. Described.
On a certain proud Spirit...
For there are many genera and species of pride...

Hence it is that (the Spirits of Mercury) are in pride; and, because they are in pride, the life of ends and uses cannot so [well] inflow into them, until this pride is taken away. It is this pride which has done most of the things which I have described...
The other, whose exteriors were full of pride; but his interiors good, was Er. Benz. Described.
Such pride produces a tickling and a rubbing of the anus.
In the world, Charles XII was inwardly the proudest of all, which caused him to want to dominate over the universe...
The reason they do not see the Angels there, is that their eyes are closed by pride...
Zinzendorf was debilitated in mind, because his pride had been depressed.
See Pride.
